themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and South America are gearing up for snap elections, presidential cycles, and legislative battles. As Spain approaches its November 29 snap vote and France's 2027 presidential positioning intensifies, right-wing factions are driving media narratives around coalition viability and polling surges.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Dominates election coverage ahead of the 29N snap election, debating potential governing coalitions with the PP while attacking the ruling PSOE.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Maintains a strong lead in 2027 presidential polls as Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella frame their platform against center-right rivals.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Mobilizes presidential candidate Karol Nawrocki for international exposure while Jarosław Kaczyński outlines strategy for returning to power.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Reaches record polling numbers of up to 35.7%, sharpening opposition to the sitting government ahead of upcoming votes.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Prepares state and municipal election campaigns while forcing center-right parties to defend political cordons sanitaires.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Leverages parliamentary clout to force debate among opposition and governing center-right parties over future coalition terms.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing platforms continue to push hardline anti-immigration policies, focusing on enforcement mechanisms, labor restrictions, and remigration concepts. Figures in Germany, the US, Norway, and the UK are coordinating rhetorical emphasis on prioritizing native citizens over foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Debates internal limits on remigration and mass deportation proposals, pushing hardline rhetoric into mainstream political discussions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Enforces E-Verify compliance on federal contractors and institutes restrictions targeting international students and mixed-status families.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Rallies against state expenditure on non-Western immigrant translation services and demands tighter integration standards.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Frames incoming migrants as threats to working-class identity and local infrastructure capacity.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders across multiple jurisdictions face intense legal scrutiny, judicial summons, and law enforcement investigations. Right-wing media outlets frame these actions as politically motivated lawfare by left-wing or establishment judicial bodies.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court Justice Moraes issues formal citations against Flávio Bolsonaro for slander while maintaining judicial restrictions on Jair Bolsonaro.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Responds to law enforcement raids and investigations into state intelligence leaks allegedly reaching Jordan Bardella's circle.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Denounces police raids targeting aligned lawyers and ongoing constitutional court disputes with Donald Tusk's administration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Faces Electoral Board sanction threats while accusing government authorities of planning electoral fraud and judicial interference.

themes.title: Transnational Friction Over US-Russia Foreign Policy
themes.blurb: European right-wing parties are grappling with divergent stances on the Ukraine war and relations with Vladimir Putin. While UK right-wingers publicly distance themselves from pro-Putin statements made in the US, French and Hungarian conservative leaders maintain skepticism toward EU aid and NATO posture.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Leaders publicly reject Donald Trump's sympathetic social media posts regarding Vladimir Putin, declaring Putin 'not a friend'.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen refuses to label Putin a war criminal and reiterates opposition to Ukraine's ascension to the European Union.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Sparks sharp debate as opposition leader Péter Magyar rejects tying Ukraine funding to the EU budget while Orbán maintains anti-Kyiv rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces heavy attacks from establishment German politicians accusing party leaders of acting as Kremlin collaborators.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Economic debates across right-wing parties center on pension reform, welfare protections for domestic workers, and state intervention against inflation. Parties balance fiscal conservatism with populist promises to protect retirees and working-class voters.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Pledges retirement at 60 for early-career workers while navigating fiscal critique over potential pension shortfalls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Proposes extending the 'Opzione Donna' early retirement scheme in the 2027 budget amendments while debating tax amnesties.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Unveils state-subsidized housing and zero-down-payment mortgage promises to counter living costs.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Navigates 2027 budget negotiations amid persistent inflation, economic recession, and declining wage purchasing power.
